sources.entry: VideoGen API - REST API with TypeScript and Python SDKs for creating editable marketing videos from storyboards, scripts and voiceovers, then editing and exporting projects; a VideoGen account and paid generation credits are required. #paid #api

summary.name: VideoGen API
summary.one_liner: A developer API and TypeScript/Python SDKs for generating videos, images, speech, music, and avatars, including end-to-end workflows like script-to-video.
use_cases: Turn a script into a captioned video programmatically
Automate video creation in CRM or CMS pipelines
Create AI images and convert them into short video clips
summary.what_it_does: VideoGen exposes REST endpoints and prebuilt SDKs (@videogen/sdk on npm, videogen on PyPI) to create videos, images, voices, and avatars. Individual tools can be called directly, or full workflows such as script-to-video and voiceover-to-video can be run in one request. The page's example code starts a script-to-video workflow with an AI image style, captions, and image-to-video conversion, then polls for a download URL. Outputs are said to be ready to embed, stream, or download, with built-in storage, transcoding, and delivery included. Webhooks and polling are offered for production pipelines.
notable: Fully typed SDKs auto-generated from an OpenAPI spec
Single API covering video, images, speech, music, and avatars plus end-to-end workflows
Built-in storage, transcoding, and global delivery of outputs
Webhooks and polling for production pipelines
caveats: Requires a VideoGen account and an API key
Paid plans; pricing listed as starting at $16/mo with flexible pricing
Paid generation credits are required, per the listing
